_note: GX-06 graphics-capture regression corpus (roadmap parity-evidence-roadmap.md §9 GX-06). Consumed by tools/parity/gx_corpus.py; the gate tools/gx_corpus.py proves every RECORDED D3D8 container opcode (orv3_format.h / the census recorded set) is covered on TWO axes: (1) a FIXTURE — a synthetic standalone D3D8 exe that exercises the opcode + replays BIT-EXACT (gx0{4,5,6_*}, verified live by test_gx0*_fixture.py); (2) a REAL PROOF — a real cached scenario whose captured container CONTAINS the opcode and passes v3verify bit-exact. Fail-closed: EVERY recorded opcode needs a fixture; every OBSERVED opcode (present in >=1 bit-exact real proof) needs a real proof too; a supported-but-UNOBSERVED opcode (0 occurrences in every cached scene) is fixture-only + recorded honestly (no real proof exists). The `opcodes`/`surfrefs`/`verify` fields on fixtures + real_proofs are ATTESTATIONS: the fast gate trusts them (no caches / no replay.exe, always runnable in the host suite); `tools/gx_corpus.py --verify` re-parses each real-proof container + re-runs v3verify + re-runs each fixture and re-STAMPS them, so the attestation cannot silently rot. Coverage unit = the container OPCODE, tied to the census recorded method(s) it captures via opcode_methods (drift-guarded: every census-recorded method must be captured by >=1 opcode or SURFREF kind, and every mapped method must actually be recorded in the census).

surfref_methods._note: SURFREF kinds are the [kind] half of a surface citation in SetRenderTarget/CopyRects (orv3_format.h). Only BACKBUFFER stands in for a distinct RECORDED method (GetBackBuffer, which has no opcode of its own — its effect is the SURFREF machinery). DEPTH/TEX/NULL are proxy classifications of the bound surface (GetDepthStencilSurface is query_only; TEX is resolved via GetContainer/GetSurfaceLevel), not standalone recorded methods — so they carry no method but still need corpus coverage for RT completeness.

unobserved_note: DrawPrimitive, DrawIndexedPrimitiveUP, CopyRects are RECORDED/supported but appear in 0 of 134 cached containers (32 scenario names, both sides, ~14.6 GB; sweep 2026-07-17). The engine's captured stream uses only DrawIndexedPrimitive + DrawPrimitiveUP and renders the pause backdrop via SetRenderTarget re-render (never a CopyRects screen-capture). These are fixture-only in the corpus; if a future scene emits one, --verify surfaces it as newly-observed and it then requires a real proof.
